implementation.behavior: successful project-scoped Environment entry appends control_project_continuation, using the exact immediate project in the authenticated execution grant and the entered Environment campaign identity
implementation.authority: Environment remains authoritative for entry, session selection, claim mutation, and campaign records; Control performs a read-only project capsule lookup after successful entry
implementation.failure_behavior: supplementary lookup failure keeps the successful entry result and reports status unknown with a diagnostic code
implementation.ownership_effect: no other session is resumed, adopted, terminated, or transferred

project_capsule.selection_behavior: both recorded contexts are shown; Control does not choose between them

canonical_live_acceptance.persistence_transport: authenticated Control Environment RPC to canonical Store; caller had no direct Store path visibility

limitations: Environment context conflict remains explicit and requires selection of the intended recorded context.

This proves the Control entry projection and canonical readback; it does not prove claim-transfer crash recovery, pre-response service interruption reconciliation, compiler resource feedback, or compiler Stage-1/Stage-2 succession.
